description: Set up a persistent SSHFS mount for a home NAS so your Raspberry Pi's shared folder appears at /Users/lume/NAS/ every time you log in. End state required on this Mac: (1) Homebrew is installed and on PATH (the `brew` binary is at /opt/homebrew/bin/brew on Apple Silicon or /usr/local/bin/brew on Intel). (2) The third-party tap `gromgit/fuse` is added (visible in `brew tap`). (3) The `sshfs` binary is installed via that tap (typically as `sshfs-mac`) and resolvable on PATH. (4) The mount point /Users/lume/NAS/ exists as an empty directory. (5) /Users/lume/.ssh/config contains a `Host homeserver` block with `HostName 192.168.1.100`, `User pi`, `Port 22`, `IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, `ServerAliveInterval 15`, `ServerAliveCountMax 3`. (6) /Users/lume/Documents/mount_nas.sh exists, is executable (chmod +x), and invokes `sshfs` to mount `homeserver:/home/pi/shared` onto /Users/lume/NAS with the macFUSE option set including at least `volname=HomeNAS`, `reconnect`, `defer_permissions`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, `IdentityFile=/Users/lume/.ssh/id_ed25519`, and `allow_other`; the script also sanity-checks that the mount point and sshfs binary exist before running. (7) /Users/lume/Library/LaunchAgents/com.lume.sshfs.homeserver.plist exists with `Label = com.lume.sshfs.homeserver`, `ProgramArguments` pointing at the mount script, `RunAtLoad = true`, `KeepAlive = true`, and `StandardOutPath`+`StandardErrorPath` pointing at log files under /Users/lume/Library/Logs/ (e.g. sshfs.homeserver.log / sshfs.homeserver.err). The agent-user account is `lume`. Do not attempt to actually mount the NAS — the macFUSE kext cannot load in this sandbox; the verifier only inspects the configuration artifacts on disk.

metadata.scoring_notes: Per-bucket scoring with binary 5-pt sub-checks within C5/C6/C7. Anti-Pattern 4: maximum partial-only credit (do-nothing artifacts: empty NAS/ dir, empty mount script, empty plist file) is bounded around 25, well below the 70 pass threshold. The toolchain installation chain (Homebrew -> gromgit tap -> sshfs binary) alone is 35 points; the SSH config + mount script + launchagent chain is 60. Either chain alone is below pass.
